utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: "Alright, let's not get ahead of ourselves. We need to weigh the pros and cons of each option. Let's start with what we've got so far."

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: "Omar's idea about the phone booths is interesting. We should look into that."

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: "I've crunched the numbers. With the phone booths, we're looking at an additional 6,400 pounds. But we're still saving around 12,000 pounds compared to mixed layouts."

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: "And we'd still have 134 desks with the phone booths. That's not too bad."

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: "True, and the phone booths would give us some quiet spaces for calls."

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: "This is a viable option. We should consider it seriously."

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: "I think this is a good compromise. It addresses the noise issue without breaking the bank."

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: "I agree. Let's go with the benching layout with the phone booths in the east corner."

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: "Sounds good to me. Let's make this our new plan."

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: "I'm happy with this decision too. Let's move forward with this."

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: "Alright, everyone. We've made our decision. Let's stick with this plan and move forward. Great job today. Let's aim to have the final layout ready by the end of the month."

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: "Sounds good. I'll start working on the revised floor plan right away."

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: "And I'll make sure to update Ibrahim and Kaveh about our decision."

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: "I'll check with Finance and make sure we're within budget."

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: "And I'll make sure to adjust the layout according to peak hours."

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: "Let's reconvene in two weeks to discuss the progress and address any new issues. Have a great rest of your day, everyone."

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: "Thanks, Noor. See you all in two weeks."

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: "Bye everyone. Let's make this happen."

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: "See you later. Let's do this."

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: "Take care, everyone. See you soon."
